title: SDK proofloop smoke scenarios and telemetry journal
content:
Purpose:
- Collect a compact set of smoke + 'proofloop' flows for SDK adopters and for CI gating. Proofloop = tiny end-to-end scenario that proves core UX, telemetry, and graceful failure together.

Audience:
- DX engineers building SDKs, integrations team, solutions engineers who run quick PoCs, and SRE for lightweight gating.

High-level constraints and goals:
- Each proofloop must run in <60s on CI with mocked runtime and <1s cold-start perceived by user in sample app.
- Telemetry hooks: track (1) first-successful-call, (2) failed-parse, (3) fallback-trigger-count, (4) token-cost-estimate.
- Keep sample apps under 300 LOC.

Core smoke scenarios (minimal):
1) hello-generate: init client, call text.generate, stream partial, close. Expect: 200, stream event sequence, telemetry event: sdk.first_call.
2) chat-with-tools: call chat with function-calls mocked, assert tool-invocation log + call metadata present. Telemetry: sdk.tool_call.
3) embed-and-search: embed two strings, index small vector set locally, nearest neighbor returns top1 match. Telemetry: embed.latency
4) network-failure-retry: simulate transient 502, client retries once with exponential backoff, fallback to cached response if enabled. Telemetry: sdk.retry, fallback.used
5) quantized-model-detect: attempt to load small quantized artifact, assert compatibility warning and quant profile telemetry.

Failure scripts (edge cases to include in smoke runbook):
- malformed-api-key -> shows clear error with remediation hint (link to console). Telemetry: auth.fail
- oversized-payload -> deterministic 413 with hint to chunking recipe
- streaming-interrupt -> client receives partial and recovers on resume
- region-mismatch -> redirect header observed and client auto-retries to new region if config.allow_redirect = true

Telemetry contract (minimal events):
- sdk.first_call: {client_version, language, route}
- sdk.call_end: {success:bool, token_count_est, duration_ms}
- sdk.telemetry_error: {error_class, retry_count}
- sdk.fallback: {policy, upstream_code}
Note: For Drive doc we don't embed JSON objects; this is the human-readable contract to be turned into the telemetry-schema PR.

Smoke CI blueprint (fast path):
- job: sdk-proofloop-smoke
  matrix: [python, node]
  steps:
    - checkout
    - install minimal deps via tox/pnpm
    - start local mock server (docker-compose small mock; <=128MB)
    - run proofloop script for each scenario in sequence
    - collect telemetry events as newline-delimited JSON (ndjson) and run a validator script that asserts presence/shape of minimal fields

Sample CLI quick commands (draft):
- redwood-sdk proofloop run --scenario hello-generate --lang python
- redwood-sdk proofloop list
- redwood-sdk proofloop report --ndjson latest.ndjson

Sample app layout idea (tiny):
- /app
  - main.(py|js) ~50 LOC: creates client, runs chosen scenario, prints human readable result + telemetry summary
  - flowspecs/*.yaml small descriptions per scenario (used by CLI)

Open questions / decisions to resolve:
- canonical telemetry field names: prefer snake_case or camelCase? (team split: infra likes snake_case; SDK libs lean camelCase)
- should proofloop run against Hosted by default or always mock? Proposal: CI = mock for speed; local CLI = hosted opt-in with dev token.
- where to store ndjson telemetry examples for regression? small bucket per team vs monorepo fixtures?
- should we include a 'cost-sanity' assert (e.g., token_est < X) in CI? Risk: flaky with model changes.

Next concrete steps (this week):
- Ben: prototype python hello-generate proofloop + ndjson emitter (due 2025-01-21)
- Maya: draft telemetry-schema PR and pick canonical casing (due 2025-01-23)
- Luca: add CI job to infra playground and verify docker mock memory footprint < 200MB (due 2025-01-28)
- Aisha (owner): consolidate feedback and open a GH RFC for proofloop naming and CLI UX (due 2025-02-03)

Quick notes to self / heuristics:
- Keep each proofloop single-purpose: devs should run one to validate one hypothesis fast.
- Favor observable output (human + ndjson) over opaque PASS/FAIL only.
- Make the CLI defaults conservative (no hosted calls) so demos are reproducible offline.

Rough checklist before marking 'in_review':
- [ ] prototype scenarios in both python and node
- [ ] telemetry schema PR merged + validator in CI
- [ ] CLI commands wired and documented in README (short)
- [ ] two sample apps added to examples/ with < 300 LOC each
- [ ] smoke job green in main branch at least once

End of journal entry.

-- Aisha
notes: this is intentionally terse; expand into formal playbook once prototypes land.
